reasons: Both fallback atomic elements are satisfied: affiliate coverage conditioned on written notice inside the Section 2(a) grant, and a consent-free carve-out in Section 15 for Client's assignment to an M&A successor.
Preferred level remains incomplete (no contractors, no perpetual/irrevocable paid-up licence, no uncured-material-breach-only termination), consistent with the locked fallback target.

Edits are two short in-sentence insertions; no preferred-only scope or duration language was imported, no new exception or undefined term introduced, and the remainder of Sections 2 and 15 (including the mutual assignment restriction and affiliate carve-out) stays effective.
